description: What the Tervin workspace window is allowed to call. Tauri 2 denies every command that is not listed here, so this file is the app's actual capability surface — not documentation of it. JSON takes no comments, so the reasoning lives in this field. Every entry has a caller: core:default is the frontend baseline that invoke and the IPC channel need; core:event listen and unlisten are api.on() in ui/src/lib/api.ts; core:window:allow-start-dragging is the data-tauri-drag-region title bar in ui/src/App.tsx; dialog:allow-open is the project picker; opener:allow-open-url is activateLink in ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx, scoped to the three schemes it can produce — http and https from the url pattern in ui/src/lib/links.ts, and mailto for an email match. opener:allow-open-path is deliberately absent. A capability scope is static JSON compiled into the binary and the project root is chosen at runtime, so "inside the project" is not a scope that can be written here; it was granted as "**", every path on disk. Opening a path now goes through the open_path command in crates/tervin-app/src/commands.rs, which resolves symlinks, compares against the live project root, and asks before leaving it. opener:default and dialog:default are not used because they would add back tel: urls, reveal-in-file-manager, and the message and save dialogs, none of which anything calls. Removed for the same reason: core:window set-title, is-maximized, toggle-maximize, minimize and close, which nothing calls because titleBarStyle Overlay leaves that work to the native traffic lights, and core:webview:allow-internal-toggle-devtools, which a release build does not compile in.
